statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The denial reason code is CO-97
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the rhythm during intermittent symptomatic events and guide further management
The service was denied as bundled into another covered procedure
